surface_mechanism_description: The growth mechanism involves the alternate adsorption of HfCl4 and hydrolysis of HfClx surface species. HfCl4 adsorbs by reacting with the OH-terminated surface recreated after every hydrolysis step, while the surface density of OH-groups increases with the decrease in the substrate temperature, in turn increasing the growth rate.
